title: Cumulative transcription factor binding and p300-mediated histone acetylation drive enhancer activation frequency.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Opened the Europe PMC supplement zip (3.1 MB): the only table, MOESM4_ESM.xlsx, is 169 rows of reference ChIP-seq accessions (GSM IDs) for 18 TFs (transcription factors), not measurements. Queried BioStudies for E-MTAB-16658/16659/16657 (MCHIRA, the ectopic reporter assay), E-MTAB-17191 and E-MTAB-14460: the first four list only idf/sdrf metadata files; E-MTAB-14460 lists 0 files. Read the MCHIRA SDRF sample sheets (58 and 48 rows): only FASTQ_URI columns, no processed/derived data files. Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20649044 is a single 82 KB code zip (CC-BY-4.0); the GitHub repo holds only R figure scripts and FootprintCharter functions.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: That MCHIRA gave sufficient coverage for 831 CREs (cis-regulatory elements) from 2,199 inserted, that 5,823 CREs lose H3K27ac (a histone acetylation mark) under p300 inhibition, and that per-figure source data exist on the publisher site (not retrieved; publisher site is out of scope).

a1_downloadable.note: Checked the files: ArrayExpress holds only raw bisulfite-sequencing FASTQ (forbidden download type for this tool); no processed accessibility table deposited in ArrayExpress, Zenodo or the Europe PMC supplement.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Checked the files: the label, chromatin accessibility (CA) frequency per enhancer, is not a column anywhere; it would have to be computed from raw single-molecule footprinting reads with the FootprintCharter pipeline.

a3_inputs_present.note: Paper text only: CRE sequences are listed in Supplementary Table 2, which is not in the Europe PMC supplement; not verified.

a4_units_stated.note: Paper text: CA frequency is a fraction of DNA molecules accessible (0–1); no table to check.

a5_enough_rows.note: Paper text only: 831 CREs measured at the ectopic locus, below the ~1,500 regression threshold; no table opened, so no verified count.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; raw targeted bisulfite FASTQ across 106+ MCHIRA runs
a6_fits_laptop.note: Producing labels requires alignment and footprint calling on raw reads, outside laptop/size policy.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No processed table exists to compare with the paper's 831 CREs.

a8_label_provenance.note: Paper text: label is a direct measurement (methylation-based single-molecule footprinting), not a model output.

backbone.name: Nucleotide Transformer / AlphaGenome (DNA) would fit 250 bp CRE sequences

integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Does sequence alone predict how often an enhancer opens when its native chromatin context is removed?

controls.positive_control: CTCF-motif CREs open autonomously at the ectopic locus (paper text).
controls.external_validation: Endogenous single-molecule footprinting of the same CREs (E-MTAB-14460, raw only).

honest_claim_h3: Not reached: no processed label table exists to model.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the DNA sequence of a short enhancer to predict how often it opens chromatin when inserted at a neutral genome site.
plain_idea.train_on: 250 bp enhancer sequences inserted at one locus in mouse embryonic stem cells; about 831 per the paper, unverified.
plain_idea.predict: The fraction of DNA molecules that are accessible at the inserted enhancer, measured by single-molecule footprinting (methylation marking of unprotected DNA, read by bisulfite sequencing).
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Separates what sequence encodes from what chromatin context adds; useful to enhancer-design and gene-regulation modelling groups.

ml_idea: Regress ectopic chromatin-accessibility frequency of ~831 enhancers on sequence embeddings; blocked because only raw FASTQ is deposited.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated: labels require reprocessing raw bisulfite reads, which is out of scope.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Look for a processed per-CRE CA-frequency table; none in ArrayExpress, Zenodo, GitHub or supplement (done, failed).

verdict_reason: Fails A1/A2: only raw bisulfite FASTQ is deposited, so the per-enhancer accessibility label must be rebuilt from reads; and the paper's 831 measured enhancers would also fall short of A5 for regression.
